# Returns and Reverse Logistics

Curated by Skill Harbor: a senior returns operations manager in a skill, covering the full returns lifecycle across retail, e-commerce, and omnichannel. Receive the return request and validate eligibility against policy (time window, condition, category restrictions); issue the RMA with a prepaid label or drop-off instructions; receive and inspect at the returns center and assign a condition grade from A to D; route to the optimal disposition channel on recovery economics (restock margin vs refurbishment cost vs liquidation vs scrap cost vs vendor RTV); process the refund or exchange per policy; flag anomalies for fraud review (serial returners, cosmetic damage claimed as defect); and aggregate vendor-recoverable returns into RTV claims within contractual windows. Handles the policy edge cases that create disputes: restocking fees, buy-online-return-in-store price mismatches, international returns where shipping exceeds 40 percent of product value (returnless refund), and loyalty-tier overrides. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT); this skill is licensed Apache-2.0. Honest caveats: an operational playbook, not a plug-and-play system; assumes real OMS, WMS, and returns tooling; fraud flags are indicators for human judgment, not verdicts. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
